sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r12/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 7 and Internal Quality Checks row 7: task_asks_for_a_real_working_product; no extra annotation column; Deterministic Checks check-instruction-content.py row noted)
evidence: Smallest submission satisfying the brief is a substantial full-stack build, not a stub or tweak. (1) Agent starts from an empty /app: .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r12/task/environment/Dockerfile:17-23 creates /app with only .gitkeep (byte-identical to template environment/Dockerfile), so there is no starter app to tweak. (2) Public ask (.qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r12/task/instruction.md:1-15; environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md sections 1-9) requires Node/Express/SQLite server with sessions and 4 roles (401/403/404 semantics, rules.md:21-23), six-stage board with one-stage moves, reject/reopen, hand ordering shared by all, interview capacity, per-card versions with 409 naming the changer (rules.md:75-80), optimistic move with put-back and focus (82-85), atomic multi-card moves in board order (87-92), single-use undo with conflict rules (94-100), notes, append-only Activity (108-113), live updates within 15 s preserving focus/draft/scroll (115-123), conversations with 30-message paging and scroll anchoring, per-person unread, seen receipts, per-user/per-conversation drafts surviving reload and session expiry (125-175), candidate portal with wording table and strict data privacy (177-194), restart persistence without reseeding (204-209). (3) The grading excludes a stub: gates (tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml hro_gate_shared) require a UI-created job and candidate read back in an independent browser context and explicitly reject 'a static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app'; tests/gates/render/judge.toml hro_gate_render requires a wrong-password refusal plus a real staff workspace, 'A static picture or only a health response is insufficient'. Functional has 44 binary criteria totalling weight 59.5 (computed with tomllib), each with a positive control, so a dead feature earns nothing. (4) Weak-app estimate: an app that only signs in, opens jobs, adds candidates with email validation and persists could at most earn hro_job_open 0.5 + hro_add_candidate 0.5 + hro_add_email_rules 1 + hro_restart 1.5 (+ perhaps hro_candidate_linked 0.5) = 3.5-4.0/59.5 ~ 6-7% functional; it clears the template floor functional=0.05 (tests/scoring.toml unchanged from template) and could take visual likert credit, but polish (5 criteria, 12.0 weight, all on live-board/thread/draft/session behaviour) would be ~0. Estimated total reward ~0.04 + <=0.2 visual, far below a real build. That is ordinary shaped-reward partial credit, not a stub earning the reward. (5) Golden is real build work: ~1,558 lines across solution/app/src/{index,db,bootstrap}.js and public/js/{app,board,threads}.js; raw evidence qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/results/workspace.json (sha256 7ae5b5c3... verified, matching_source_files hashes all equal frozen bytes) records 25/25 scripted golden groups passing with no page errors - scripted golden observation only, not a judge run. Conforming alternative check: drag-only is not required (drag optional), polling/SSE/sockets all allowed (rules.md:123), routes/labels free (rules.md:3-5, app_context.md) - no hidden mandate that inflates the ask artificially. Risk=true because reward discrimination is unmeasured: raw-evidence-index scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent', so the stub-vs-real reward separation above is a source-based estimate, not a measured weak-app run.
